title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,601–5,650 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 高山登山運動；百岳縱走攀登

examples.en: Alpine mountaineering in Taiwan's Central Mountain Range demands thorough training and endurance.
examples.zh: 挑戰攀登台灣中央山脈險峻高山縱走，需要扎實體能訓練與強大耐力。

examples.en: She took courses in technical mountaineering before attempting her first winter expedition.
examples.zh: 在嘗試生平第一次雪期遠征之前，她先報名參加了技術性登山訓練課程。

examples.en: Mountaineering clubs organize multi-day treks through the Shei-Pa mountain wilderness each autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，各登山社團都會在雪霸國家公園的崇山荒野中籌辦數日長途縱走。

words.definition: 百岳山巔峰頂；成功登頂

examples.en: Hikers celebrated under clear blue skies upon reaching the summit of Yushan Main Peak at 3,952 meters.
examples.zh: 歷經數小時長途跋涉，山友們在海拔 3,952 公尺的玉山主峰山頂峰頂迎著藍天歡呼登頂。

examples.en: The expedition team plans to summit Mount Nanhu at dawn before strong afternoon winds pick up.
examples.zh: 遠征隊計劃於黎明時分登頂南湖大山，搶在午後強陣風增強前完成攻頂。

examples.en: Heavy snowfall forced the climbing party to turn around just two hundred meters below the summit.
examples.zh: 猛烈的大雪迫使攀登隊伍在距離山頂僅剩兩百公尺處被迫下撤。

words.definition: 海拔高度；高地高處

examples.en: Rapid gains in elevation above 3,000 meters cause thinner air and cooler ambient temperatures.
examples.zh: 當登山健行海拔高度驟升至三千公尺以上時，空氣將變得稀薄且氣溫驟降。

examples.en: This weather station sits at an elevation of 2,800 meters on the Hehuanshan highway pass.
examples.zh: 這座高山氣象觀測站坐落於合歡山公路埡口、海拔兩千八百公尺的高地上。

examples.en: As your elevation increases, atmospheric pressure drops, requiring your lungs to work harder.
examples.zh: 隨著你所處的海拔高度增加，大氣壓力隨之下降，肺部需要更費力運作以吸取氧氣。

words.definition: 高海拔漸進式適應 (預防高山症)

examples.en: Spending a night at 2,500 meters assists gradual body acclimation, preventing severe mountain sickness.
examples.zh: 在海拔兩千五百公尺的山莊先宿一夜進行高度適應，能有效防範急性高山症發生。

examples.en: Proper altitude acclimation involves ascending slowly and drinking plenty of warm fluids.
examples.zh: 妥善的高山適應關鍵在於緩步爬升，並隨時補充充足的溫開水。

examples.en: The itinerary builds in two rest days at base camp to ensure thorough physical acclimation.
examples.zh: 行程特別在基地營規劃了兩天適應休整日，以確保隊員身體完全適應稀薄空氣。

words.definition: 高海拔大腦缺氧狀態；組織缺氧

examples.en: Carrying portable pulse oximeters allows climbers to monitor blood oxygen levels and detect hypoxia early.
examples.zh: 隨身攜帶脈搏血氧儀能隨時監測血液含氧量，在第一時間揪出大腦與組織高山缺氧徵兆。

examples.en: Symptoms of acute hypoxia include dizziness, shortness of breath, and impaired judgment.
examples.zh: 急性高山缺氧的典型症狀包含暈眩、呼吸急促以及認知判斷力下降。

examples.en: When blood saturation falls below eighty percent due to hypoxia, the climber must descend immediately.
examples.zh: 一旦因高空缺氧導致血氧飽和度跌破百分之八十，登山者必須毫無遲疑立刻下撤。

words.definition: 丹木斯 (Diamox 高山症預防用藥)

examples.en: Doctors prescribe acetazolamide (Diamox) to accelerate breathing rates and mitigate acute altitude symptoms.
examples.zh: 登山醫師建議出發前一天開始服用丹木斯，能刺激呼吸以預防高山頭痛與嘔吐。

examples.en: Mild tingling in fingers and toes is a common, harmless side effect of acetazolamide.
examples.zh: 手指和腳趾出現輕微發麻針刺感，是服用丹木斯時常見且無害的副作用。

examples.en: Taking acetazolamide twelve hours prior to ascending gives your metabolism time to adjust.
examples.zh: 在急速爬升前十二小時服用丹木斯，能給予身體新陳代謝充分的調適時間。

words.definition: 險峻刀片岩稜線；山脊山稜

examples.en: Traversing the exposed rocky knife-edge ridge of Mount Dabajian demands steady balance and nerves of steel.
examples.zh: 橫渡大霸尖山與五岩峰險峻裸露的刀片岩稜，需要絕佳的下肢平衡感與鋼鐵般的勇氣。

examples.en: High winds howl fiercely across the exposed ridge, making upright walking dangerous.
examples.zh: 強風在毫無遮蔽的山脊稜線上猛烈呼嘯，讓站立直行變得極為兇險。

examples.en: The panoramic trail follows a narrow mountain ridge connecting the northern and eastern peaks.
examples.zh: 這條景觀絕佳的稜線步道，沿著狹長的山稜蜿蜒連接北峰與東峰。

words.definition: 陡峭落石碎石坡；崩壁滑石

examples.en: Crossing the steep scree slope below the main peak requires deliberate footing to avoid triggering rockslides.
examples.zh: 橫切主峰下方陡峭鬆散的碎石坡崩壁，每一步皆需踩實以防觸發落石滑墜。

examples.en: Descending loose scree feels like skiing on gravel, so gaiters are essential to keep rocks out.
examples.zh: 踩著鬆軟的碎石坡下山宛如在石礫上滑雪，因此綁腿絕對不可或缺以防碎石入鞋。

examples.en: A massive wall of scree collapsed during the earthquake, blocking the traditional trail route.
examples.zh: 地震期間大片崩坍的碎石滑落，將傳統登山路徑徹底掩埋阻斷。

words.definition: 千仞絕壁大斷崖；懸崖峭壁

examples.en: Towering vertical limestone cliffs drop hundreds of meters straight into the roaring Taroko Gorge.
examples.zh: 太魯閣國家公園兩側高聳入雲的千仞大理石絕壁懸崖，筆直向下直插轟鳴的立霧溪谷。

examples.en: Warning signs caution hikers to stay well away from the crumbling edge of the ocean cliff.
examples.zh: 警示牌告誡健行登山客務必遠離容易風化崩落的海崖邊緣。

examples.en: Rock climbers inspected safety anchors before repelling down the granite cliff face.
examples.zh: 攀岩者在沿著花崗岩峭壁垂降前，仔細檢查了岩壁上的固定錨點與安全吊帶。

words.definition: 高山野外古道登山步道；小徑

examples.en: The rugged historical alpine trail winds through pristine hemlock forests and alpine bamboo meadows.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒起伏的高山歷史登山古道步道，穿梭在參天鐵杉原始林與翠綠高山箭竹草原之間。

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rains washed away several sections of the remote mountain trail.
examples.zh: 連日強烈西南氣流暴雨沖毀了這條偏遠山區步道的數個路段。

examples.en: National park rangers maintain trail markers to ensure solitary backpackers stay on course.
examples.zh: 國家公園巡山員定期維護步道路標與反光標誌，確保獨攀山友不致偏離路徑。

words.definition: 輕量化 50 公升專業登山重裝大背包

examples.en: The ergonomic 50-liter backpack transfers heavy tent and food loads comfortably onto the hiker’s hip belt.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的五十公升專業登山大背包，能將帳篷與糧食重量穩穩轉移至腰帶支撐。

examples.en: Many university students plan to backpack across Taiwan’s scenic mountain ranges this summer.
examples.zh: 許多大學生計劃今年暑假背起大背包，徒步縱走台灣壯闊的百岳山脈。

examples.en: Inspect all buckle stitching and zipper seams before loading your heavy mountain backpack.
examples.zh: 在打包重裝登山大背包前，請務必逐一檢查所有扣具車縫線與拉鍊接縫。

words.definition: 輕量化登山裝備 (UL 基礎重量) 的

examples.en: Thru-hikers prefer ultralight Dyneema fabric backpacks to keep their base pack weight under five kilograms.
examples.zh: 追求長程縱走的健行者鍾情於採用超輕纖維布料的輕量化裝備，將無水糧基重壓至五公斤內。

examples.en: Investing in ultralight titanium pots and carbon poles reduces cumulative physical fatigue.
examples.zh: 投資超輕量純鈦鍋具與碳纖維登山杖，能大幅降低長途行軍累積的身體疲倦。

examples.en: The ultralight movement encourages hikers to carry only functional necessities without sacrificing safety.
examples.zh: 輕量化登山理念倡導在不犧牲安全的前提下，精簡行囊並只攜帶具實質功能的必需品。

words.definition: Gore-Tex 防水黃金大底高筒登山鞋

examples.en: Rugged waterproof footwear with stiff Vibram outsoles protects ankles when hiking over wet, mossy roots.
examples.zh: 搭載黃金抓地大底與防水透氣膜的專業登山鞋，在踩踏濕滑樹根與泥濘時能牢牢保護腳踝。

examples.en: Breaking in new hiking footwear before a long mountain trip prevents painful friction blisters.
examples.zh: 在展開長程高山縱走之前先將新登山鞋充分穿軟磨合，可有效避免腳跟起磨擦水泡。

examples.en: Choosing appropriate footwear suited to rocky terrain prevents slips on slick mud.
examples.zh: 針對多岩石濕滑地形挑選合適的專業鞋履，能在泥濘濕滑路面上提供卓越防滑力。

words.definition: 超輕碳纖維登山杖 (雙杖平衡)；竿

examples.en: Using dual carbon fiber trekking poles absorbs 25% of knee impact during steep three-hour descents.
examples.zh: 在連續三個小時的陡峭下坡路段使用雙碳纖維登山杖，能吸收膝關節兩成五衝擊力。

examples.en: Adjust the length of your trekking pole so that your elbow forms a ninety-degree angle.
examples.zh: 適度調整登山杖長度，使手臂手肘在握持時呈現穩定的九十度直角。

examples.en: One aluminum pole bent under sudden pressure when she slipped on a muddy riverbank.
examples.zh: 當她在濕滑溪岸邊滑倒時，受突如其來的側向衝擊導致其中一根鋁合金手杖彎折。

words.definition: 防水防砂防泥登山短綁腿

examples.en: Wearing breathable trail gaiters over your boots prevents dirt, pebbles, and morning dew from entering.
examples.zh: 在登山鞋口套上一對透氣抗撕裂登山綁腿，能徹底阻擋碎石、泥巴與晨間露水滲入鞋內。

examples.en: High-cut waterproof gaiters are crucial when wading through overgrown, wet sword grass.
examples.zh: 穿行在露水未乾的高山箭竹與芒草密林中時，高筒防水綁腿能保持褲管全乾。

examples.en: Ensure the underfoot strap of each gaiter is securely tightened before starting the hike.
examples.zh: 出發前務必確認綁腿底部扣帶已牢固扣緊於鞋底凹槽中。

words.definition: 冬季雪攀十爪鋼製防滑冰爪

examples.en: Fastening ten-point steel crampons to boots provides bite on icy snowfields during winter Yushan ascents.
examples.zh: 冬季雪攀玉山時，在鞋底緊密綁上十爪鍛造鋼製防滑冰爪，能在結冰硬雪面上穩穩抓地。

examples.en: Always practice strapping on crampons while wearing thick gloves before heading into the snow.
examples.zh: 進入雪季高山前，務必戴著厚保暖手套反覆練習穿脫冰爪的操作熟練度。

examples.en: Sharp front points on rigid crampons allow mountaineers to kick steps into vertical blue ice.
examples.zh: 硬底冰爪前方的鋒利前齒，能讓技術攀登者在近乎垂直的硬冰面上踢出受力踏點。

words.definition: 登山冰斧 (滑墜自我制動煞車)；斧頭

examples.en: Practicing self-arrest maneuvers with an ice axe is a life-saving skill required for snowy ridge crossings.
examples.zh: 熟練運用登山冰斧執行滑墜自我制動煞車，是安全橫渡積雪稜線的保命必備技能。

examples.en: Carry your mountain ice axe with the pick facing backward whenever walking on slopes.
examples.zh: 在斜坡雪面行走時，應將冰斧尖嘴朝後手握把頭以利隨時反應制動。

examples.en: He swung the adze of his ice axe to chip away frozen snow and create a flat resting ledge.
examples.zh: 他揮動冰斧的鏟頭削去凍結的硬雪層，在陡坡上開鑿出一個平坦的踏足休息點。

words.definition: 洋蔥式三層穿法 (排汗保暖防風雨)

examples.en: Effective clothing layering allows hikers to shed a fleece when climbing and bundle up during summit winds.
examples.zh: 遵循科學的洋蔥式分層穿法，能在劇烈爬坡時迅速脫去中層，在山頂強風中套上防風外套。

examples.en: Mastering the three-tier layering system prevents both shivering cold and excessive sweat accumulation.
examples.zh: 掌握戶外三層式穿衣哲學，既能防止受風寒打哆嗦，又能杜絕汗水大量滯留。

examples.en: Outdoor guides emphasize strategic layering because damp clothes in freezing weather spell danger.
examples.zh: 高山嚮導一再強調洋蔥穿法的重要性，因為在嚴寒高山中衣服濕透往往意味著危險降臨。

words.definition: 頂級美麗諾羊毛排汗保暖底層衣

examples.en: A 200gsm merino wool base layer keeps you dry, regulates body temperature, and naturally resists odor for days.
examples.zh: 兩百克重的天然美麗諾羊毛排汗衣，透氣恆溫且連續穿著數天縱走依然毫無汗臭異味。

examples.en: Unlike synthetic fabrics, high-grade merino fibers retain warmth even when slightly damp from sweat.
examples.zh: 與一般化學合成纖維不同，頂級美麗諾羊毛纖維即便微受汗氣沾濕，依然保有優異保暖度。

examples.en: Backpackers invest in fine merino wool socks to prevent blistering and cushion feet on long marches.
examples.zh: 重裝背包客捨得投資高級美麗諾羊毛襪，以提供足部緩衝並防止長途行軍磨出水泡。

words.definition: 透氣立體格紋刷毛保暖中層衣

examples.en: Grid-pattern fleece midlayers trap insulating body warmth while venting excess sweat vapor rapidly.
examples.zh: 採用立體格狀織法的刷毛保暖中層，在牢牢鎖住體溫的同時能迅速排出高強度行進時的汗氣。

examples.en: He tossed a lightweight fleece jacket into his daypack for when resting on windy ridges.
examples.zh: 他在隨身攻頂小包中隨手塞入一件輕量刷毛外套，以備在強風稜線上停步休息時保暖。

examples.en: Modern technical fleece dries quickly when hung overnight in a ventilated backcountry cabin.
examples.zh: 現代高機能刷毛面料快乾性極佳，掛在高山避難山屋通風處晾曬一夜便能完全乾透。

words.definition: 800FP 高蓬鬆度極輕鵝絨羽絨外套

examples.en: Pulling on a high-fill-power goose down jacket restores cozy warmth the minute you arrive at the cold camp.
examples.zh: 一抵達氣溫逼近冰點的露營地，立即套上一件極輕高蓬鬆度羽絨外套，瞬間驅散刺骨寒氣。

examples.en: Compressible down jackets pack into tiny sacks, saving precious room inside your hiking bag.
examples.zh: 高壓縮比的羽絨衣可壓縮收納進微小收納袋中，為登山背包省下寶貴的收納空間。

examples.en: Keep your down garments inside a waterproof dry bag, as wet down loses all insulating loft.
examples.zh: 務必將羽絨衣物裝在防水袋內保存，因為潮濕的羽毛會完全塌陷並喪失所有隔熱保暖能力。

words.definition: 三層頂級防水透氣風雨衣硬殼外套

examples.en: A rugged 3-layer Gore-Tex hardshell jacket blocks torrential typhoon downpours and sub-zero gale winds.
examples.zh: 專業三層複合防水透氣硬殼風雨衣，能無畏抵禦狂風暴雨與高山零下刺骨強風。

examples.en: Pit zips on a mountain hardshell allow excess heat to escape while keeping rain outside.
examples.zh: 專業硬殼雨衣腋下的雙向通風拉鍊，能在徹底隔絕雨水的同時排出爬坡產生的大量悶熱。

examples.en: Never set foot on a multi-day high mountain traverse without a proven waterproof hardshell.
examples.zh: 凡參與數日高山百岳縱走，行囊中絕對不可缺少一件通過嚴苛防水考驗的硬殼風雨衣。

words.definition: 高山失溫致死危機；體溫過低

examples.en: Wet cotton shirts and freezing winds rapidly cause hypothermia, making quick dry clothing changes critical.
examples.zh: 穿著濕透的棉質衣物吹冷風會迅速導致致命失溫症，抵達營地必須立即換上全乾保暖衣。

examples.en: Recognizing uncontrollable shivering and slurred speech allows quick action against hypothermia.
examples.zh: 能辨識出無法控制的劇烈顫抖與言語不清，有助於第一時間阻斷失溫症的惡化。

examples.en: The team quickly sheltered the hiker inside a tent to treat early stages of hypothermia with warm broth.
examples.zh: 登山隊伍迅速將該名山友安置進帳篷內，餵飲溫熱高湯以治療初期的失溫現象。

words.definition: 鋁箔緊急防風防雨保暖露宿袋

examples.en: An emergency aluminized bivy sack reflects 90% of radiant body heat if forced to spend an unexpected night outside.
examples.zh: 一個僅重百克的鋁箔緊急露宿袋，在意外受困荒野時能反射九成體溫，成為救命保暖方舟。

examples.en: Every responsible hiker carries a lightweight bivy in their pocket in case of sudden stranding.
examples.zh: 每位具備安全責任感的山友都會在外套口袋常備輕量露宿袋，以防遭遇突發受困。

examples.en: Crawling into a waterproof bivy protected the lost mountaineer from driving rain until morning.
examples.zh: 鑽入防水透氣露宿袋中，保護了迷途受困的登山客抵禦徹夜風雨襲擊直至清晨救援抵達。

words.definition: 四季抗暴風高山幾何圓頂帳篷的

examples.en: Geodesic dome tents with crossing aluminum poles withstand 80 km/h summit gusts without collapsing.
examples.zh: 採用多桿交錯幾何結構的抗暴風圓頂帳篷，能穩穩抵禦八級陣風吹襲而不變形倒塌。

examples.en: The geodesic tent frame distributes wind load evenly across all structural joints.
examples.zh: 幾何圓頂帳篷的多桿交叉受力結構，能將猛烈風壓平均分散至整體骨架節點。

examples.en: Winter expeditions rely on sturdy geodesic architectures to prevent heavy snow load collapses.
examples.zh: 冬季雪攀遠征仰賴堅固的幾何結構抗暴風帳，以防厚重積雪壓垮帳身造成危險。

words.definition: 零下極限溫標木乃伊式羽絨睡袋

examples.en: The mummy sleeping bag wraps snugly around the head and shoulders to lock in body heat on freezing nights.
examples.zh: 貼合人體身形的木乃伊式羽絨睡袋，連帽收繩包覆頭部，在零下冰夜中封存每一絲體溫。

examples.en: Mummy-shaped sacks minimize empty interior space, meaning your body wastes less energy warming air.
examples.zh: 木乃伊造型睡袋能大幅減少內部多餘空間，這意味著身體無須耗損額外熱能加熱死角空氣。

examples.en: She pulled the drawcord tight around her mummy hood to seal out the freezing mountain air.
examples.zh: 她拉緊木乃伊連帽的彈性收口繩，將刺骨的高山凍氣徹底阻隔於睡袋之外。

words.definition: 高 R 值隔絕地氣充氣保暖睡墊；墊子

examples.en: An insulated air sleeping pad with an R-value of 4.5 stops the frozen ground from sucking away body heat.
examples.zh: 具備 R 值 4.5 以上的隔熱充氣睡墊，能徹底阻隔高山凍土地表所吸走的刺骨寒氣。

examples.en: Don't rely solely on a sleeping bag; a proper sleeping pad is what truly isolates you from ground cold.
examples.zh: 別只顧著依賴睡袋保暖；一張合格的隔熱防潮睡墊才是真正阻隔地表寒氣的關鍵所在。

examples.en: He inflated his ultralight sleeping pad using a lightweight pump sack in under three minutes.
examples.zh: 他使用隨附的超輕充氣袋充填睡墊，不到三分鐘就將充氣睡墊充得飽滿堅挺。

words.definition: 快速防風一體式高山攻頂爐具；爐子

examples.en: The integrated canister stove boils half a liter of glacial stream water in ninety seconds in howling winds.
examples.zh: 搭載熱交換聚能環的一體式防風攻頂爐，在狂風中僅需九十秒即可將冰涼溪水煮至沸騰。

examples.en: Always check the rubber O-ring seal on your backpacking stove before screwing in the gas canister.
examples.zh: 在將高山瓦斯罐旋入登山爐頭前，請務必先確認爐具底部的橡膠防漏迫緊環完整無缺。

examples.en: Micro-regulator stoves maintain a steady flame output even when temperatures dip near freezing.
examples.zh: 搭載微調穩壓結構的高山瓦斯爐，即便在氣溫逼近冰點的低溫環境下依然能維持穩定火力。

words.definition: 凍乾輕量高熱量登山乾燥飯料理包的

examples.en: Freeze-dried trekking meal pouches are featherlight, rehydrating into steaming chicken risotto after ten minutes.
examples.zh: 超輕量的急速凍乾料理包，注入滾水燜泡十分鐘即可化為一碗熱氣騰騰的香濃燉飯。

examples.en: Packing freeze-dried rations cuts pack weight dramatically on seven-day wilderness expeditions.
examples.zh: 在為期七天的高山縱走中攜帶凍乾糧食乾燥飯包，能戲劇性地減輕背包的總負重負擔。

examples.en: Pour boiling water directly into the freeze-dried foil pouch and stir well before resealing.
examples.zh: 將滾燙開水直接注入鋁箔凍乾餐袋中，以長柄湯匙徹底拌勻後密封等待享用。

words.definition: 中空纖維高山溪水過濾除菌器

examples.en: Squeezing murky river water through a 0.1-micron hollow-fiber filtration device removes bacteria and protozoa.
examples.zh: 將混濁的山澗溪水擠過 0.1 微米中空纖維微孔過濾器，能在瞬間濾除 99.9% 細菌與原蟲。

examples.en: Reliable water filtration protects long-distance hikers against debilitating giardia infections.
examples.zh: 隨身攜帶可靠的登山濾水器過濾水源，能保護長程健行者免於罹患令人虛脫的梨形鞭毛蟲症。

examples.en: Backflush your filtration cartridge regularly with clean water to prevent silt from clogging the flow.
examples.zh: 定期使用乾淨清水對濾水器濾芯進行反向沖洗，可避免泥沙沉積阻塞出水流量。

words.definition: 二氧化氯高山水源淨水發泡錠；藥片

examples.en: Dropping a chemical purification tablet into your water bottle neutralizes waterborne viruses within thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 在水壺中投入一顆二氧化氯淨水錠，靜置半小時即可徹底殺滅各種水生病毒。

examples.en: Chlorine dioxide tablets leave minimal aftertaste while killing stubborn aquatic pathogens.
examples.zh: 二氧化氯化學淨水發泡錠在殺滅頑強水生病原體的同時，幾乎不會殘留令人不適的藥水味。

examples.en: Keep emergency purification tablets in your first-aid kit as a backup to mechanical filters.
examples.zh: 在個人急救包中常備幾顆緊急淨水藥片，可作為濾水器結冰損壞時的可靠備援。

words.definition: 400 流明紅光夜間行進登山頭燈

examples.en: The waterproof LED headlamp casts a bright 400-lumen beam for 3:00 AM alpine summit pushes in the dark.
examples.zh: 凌晨三點摸黑出發攻頂時，戴在額頭上的高亮度防水登山頭燈照亮腳下的崎嶇山路。

examples.en: Switch your headlamp to red-light mode inside shared huts to avoid blinding sleeping mountaineers.
examples.zh: 在避難山屋內部請務必將頭燈切換至紅光模式，以免刺眼的白光照醒正在沉睡的山友。

examples.en: Pack spare lithium batteries in a warm inner pocket because sub-zero cold drains headlamp power quickly.
examples.zh: 將備用鋰電池放置在貼身保暖內袋中，因為零下低溫會讓頭燈電力以驚人速度衰減。

words.definition: 智慧手機離線 GPX 航跡登山地圖的

examples.en: Downloading offline topo maps with GPX tracks onto your smartphone ensures you never lose the unmarked trail.
examples.zh: 出發前在手機登山 App 中預先下載離線等高線地圖與 GPX 航跡，確保在無訊號深山中絕不迷途。

examples.en: When hiking beyond cellular signal ranges, an offline navigation app becomes your primary compass.
examples.zh: 當行進深入手機基地台無訊號覆蓋的深山時，離線地圖導航功能便成為你的救命指針。

examples.en: Verify that your downloaded offline map data covers surrounding ridgelines in case of route diversions.
examples.zh: 務必核對預先下載的離線圖資是否涵蓋周邊所有稜線路徑，以防遭遇突發路況需臨時改道。

words.definition: 雙向低軌衛星 SOS 應急救命通訊機

examples.en: The handheld satellite communicator sends two-way text messages and SOS distress coordinates from dead zones.
examples.zh: 掌上型衛星救命通訊機，在無手機訊號的深山中隨時可發送衛星簡訊與 SOS 求救座標。

examples.en: Family members tracked his solo wilderness progress in real time via the connected communicator.
examples.zh: 牽掛的家人透過通訊機傳回的即時衛星定位點，在家中就能隨時追蹤他獨攀的平安進度。

examples.en: In life-threatening emergencies, pressing the SOS button on your communicator summons helicopter rescue.
examples.zh: 面臨攸關性命的危急險境時，按壓通訊機上的 SOS 救援按鈕即可迅速召喚空勤搜救直升機。

words.definition: 個人應急指位無線電求救示標 (PLB)

examples.en: Triggering the personal locator beacon broadcasts a 406 MHz emergency signal directly to search-and-rescue satellites.
examples.zh: 一旦遭遇重大山難啟動個人應急示標，即刻向國際搜救衛星發射 406MHz 高功率救援信號。

examples.en: A dedicated emergency beacon has dedicated battery power guaranteed for years without recharging.
examples.zh: 專用的緊急救難定位示標具備原廠封裝長效電池，保證數年之內無需反覆充電隨時待命。

examples.en: Rescuers tracked the beacon's homing frequency to locate the injured climber in dense fog.
examples.zh: 搜救人員循著示標發出的定向導引頻率穿透濃霧，迅速尋獲受傷受困的登山客。

words.definition: 全民落實 LNT 無痕山林崇高精神；痕跡

examples.en: Embracing the Leave No Trace ethos means leaving nothing behind on the trail except footprints.
examples.zh: 堅定落實無痕山林原則，意味著除了足跡什麼都不留，除了回憶什麼都不帶走。

examples.en: The seven Leave No Trace principles educate hikers on respecting wildlife and minimizing campfire scars.
examples.zh: 無痕山林七大原則教育所有山友尊重高山野生動物，並竭力消除任何營火遺留的傷疤痕跡。

examples.en: True mountaineers strive to leave no trace of human presence in sensitive alpine ecological habitats.
examples.zh: 真正的山行者竭力在脆弱的高山生態棲地中隱去一切足跡，不留下一絲人為破壞痕跡。

words.definition: 輕量純鈦貓鏟 (挖掘 15 公分貓坑)

examples.en: Hikers use a lightweight titanium trowel to dig a six-inch cathole 60 meters away from water sources.
examples.zh: 健行者使用隨身攜帶的超輕純鈦登山貓鏟，在距離水源六十公尺外挖掘深十五公分的貓坑掩埋便溺。

examples.en: Carry a sturdy trowel on your belt so you can quickly manage waste without disturbing fragile roots.
examples.zh: 在背包隨手處配備一把堅固貓鏟，能讓你在野外迅速如廁處理排泄物而不破壞周遭脆弱樹根。

examples.en: Once finished, use the trowel to replace the excavated soil and disguise the cathole with natural leaf litter.
examples.zh: 如廁完畢後，用貓鏟將挖出的泥土回填並鋪上落葉腐殖質偽裝，維持荒野原始風貌。

words.definition: 垃圾廚餘衛生紙百分之百全數背下山

examples.en: Carrying ziplock bags to pack out all garbage, orange peels, and used tissues preserves pristine mountain beauty.
examples.zh: 準備好雙層夾鏈密封袋將所有個人果皮垃圾與衛生紙百分之百背下山，共同守護純淨聖境。

examples.en: Food garbage left at backcountry camps attracts black bears and alters natural foraging behaviors.
examples.zh: 遺留在山區營地的廚餘果皮垃圾會引來台灣黑熊覓食，進而破壞野生動物天然覓食習性。

examples.en: Volunteers hauled twenty kilograms of historical trail garbage down from the high alpine ridge.
examples.zh: 淨山志工們合力從高海拔稜線上，將重達二十公斤的歷史人為垃圾全數背運下山清理。

words.definition: 台灣特有種國寶長鬃山羊 (野山羊)

examples.en: The agile endemic Taiwan serow hops effortlessly across dizzying ninety-degree vertical rocky crags.
examples.zh: 台灣特有種國寶台灣長鬃山羊，能在令人頭暈目眩的九十度垂直岩壁上如履平地靈巧跳躍。

examples.en: Dawn hikers caught a glimpse of a solitary serow nibbling tender shoots on a foggy cliffside.
examples.zh: 晨起攻頂的山友在薄霧瀰漫的懸崖邊，驚喜目睹了一隻落單長鬃山羊正優雅啃食嫩芽。

examples.en: Taiwan serow have specialized cloven hooves that grip steep bare shale and slate with ease.
examples.zh: 台灣長鬃山羊演化出特殊的蹄部分裂構造，能緊緊吸附並穩抓陡峭裸露的頁岩與板岩。

words.definition: 台灣千元大鈔國寶鳥黑長尾雉 (帝雉)

examples.en: The regal Mikado pheasant steps majestically through the misty hemlock underbrush at twilight.
examples.zh: 身披深藍光澤羽毛的台灣帝雉，在薄霧繚繞的黃昏鐵杉林下優雅從容漫步。

examples.en: Spotting an elusive native pheasant along the foggy trail is considered a moment of pure mountain luck.
examples.zh: 能在霧氣蒸騰的高山小徑邊邂逅這只行蹤隱密的國寶黑長尾雉，被山友視為難得的福氣。

examples.en: The striking royal blue plumage of the male Mikado pheasant glistened after the afternoon mountain shower.
examples.zh: 午後雷陣雨剛過，雄性帝雉身上宛若藍寶石般的華美羽毛在微光中閃耀著高貴光澤。

words.definition: 經百年風雪雕塑之蒼勁玉山圓柏

examples.en: Gnarled dwarf Taiwan alpine juniper trees survive howling sub-zero winter blizzards for centuries on ridges.
examples.zh: 盤根錯節、蒼勁挺拔的玉山圓柏，在稜線上傲然歷經數百年冰雪風霜的洗禮而生生不息。

examples.en: Twisted branches of ancient juniper cling tenaciously to the cracked granite rocks near the summit.
examples.zh: 歲月淬鍊的古老圓柏扭曲枝條，緊密攀附在接近山頂的龜裂花崗岩縫隙中。

examples.en: The wind-sculpted bonsai forms of alpine juniper stand as enduring monuments to natural endurance.
examples.zh: 經受強烈季風長年雕塑的高山圓柏如自然盆景，成為大自然堅韌生命力的永恆象徵。

words.definition: 初夏五月盛開之玉山杜鵑漫山花海

examples.en: In May, pink and white alpine rhododendron blossoms blanket rocky mountainsides in stunning pastel colors.
examples.zh: 每逢初夏五月，漫山遍野盛開的粉白玉山杜鵑花海，將崢嶸高山石壁染成一片浪漫仙境。

examples.en: Thousands of visitors hike the ridges of Mount Hehuan to witness the annual rhododendron bloom.
examples.zh: 每年成千上萬的遊客湧入合歡山稜線步道，爭睹一年一度盛開的玉山杜鵑壯麗花海。

examples.en: The thick leathery leaves of the alpine rhododendron help it conserve moisture against harsh alpine winds.
examples.zh: 玉山杜鵑肉厚且覆有蠟質的革質葉片，能有效鎖住水分抵禦高山乾冷強風的吹襲。

words.definition: 巨木參天雲霧繚繞高山青苔霧林的

examples.en: Sunlight filters through ancient mossy cypress groves, creating an enchanted fairy-tale atmosphere.
examples.zh: 晨曦穿透高山雲霧，灑在長滿翠綠青苔的千年古檜木巨木群上，營造出宛如童話般的夢幻氛圍。

examples.en: Slipping on slick mossy logs is a frequent hazard during wet descents through cloud forests.
examples.zh: 踩在長滿濕滑青苔的腐木橫枝上滑倒，是穿行於雲霧林下坡時最常見的跌傷隱患。

examples.en: The soft mossy carpet beneath giant Taiwan red cypresses holds precious rainwater like a sponge.
examples.zh: 台灣紅檜巨木腳下鋪滿的翠綠柔軟苔蘚地毯，如海綿般吸飽並涵養了豐沛珍貴的山泉雨水。

words.definition: 傍晚萬丈金光壯麗高山雲海雲瀑奇景

examples.en: A spectacular sea of clouds caused by a temperature inversion rolled over the mountain pass at sunset.
examples.zh: 傍晚因高空逆溫形成的萬頃壯麗雲海與奔騰雲瀑，在夕陽餘暉映照下如金色浪濤翻滾。

examples.en: Trapped cooler air in the valley created a cloud inversion that stretched to the horizon.
examples.zh: 山谷中滯留的冷空氣釀成了高空逆溫層，催生出一望無際、蔓延至天際線的壯麗雲海。

examples.en: From the high peak, looking down at a vast cloud inversion feels like gazing across a foaming ocean.
examples.zh: 佇立在三千公尺高峰俯瞰波瀾壯闊的逆溫雲海，宛如居高臨下凝視著翻騰洶湧的白色汪洋。

words.definition: 站在百岳稜線上迎接第一道璀璨日出

examples.en: Tears of joy welled up as golden morning sunbeams illuminated the peaks during the mountaintop sunrise.
examples.zh: 當清晨第一道璀璨金光穿破雲海、照亮群峰頂端時，佇立在山頂迎候百岳日出的每個人心中熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: Hundreds of early risers bundled in down jackets waited patiently for the magnificent mountain sunrise.
examples.zh: 數百名清晨摸黑起身的登山者裹著厚羽絨外套，屏氣凝神等候那氣勢磅礡的崇山日出。

examples.en: The eastern horizon turned brilliant orange moments before the dazzling alpine sunrise broke through the mist.
examples.zh: 在奪目的百岳日出破霧而出前的一剎那，東方地平線被渲染成一片萬丈絢爛的金橙色彩。

words.definition: 原始壯麗高山無人荒野自然聖境

examples.en: Trekking deep into the untamed mountain wilderness disconnects you from modern stress and heals the soul.
examples.zh: 縱身走入未經人工雕琢的原始高山荒野，徹底切斷都市塵囂壓力，獲得心靈的深沉療癒。

examples.en: Preserving vast stretches of roadless wilderness is vital for protecting endangered wildlife corridors.
examples.zh: 保留連綿廣袤、無人工車道侵擾的高山蠻荒曠野，對維繫瀕危野生動物的生態廊道至關重要。

examples.en: He spent two weeks navigating trackless wilderness, relying solely on map, compass, and mountain sense.
examples.zh: 他在杳無人煙的原始荒野中獨自跋涉了兩週，全憑紙本地圖、指北針與直覺山感指引方向。

words.definition: 仰望崇山峻嶺之由衷謙卑敬畏

examples.en: Standing beneath towering 3,000-meter peaks instills profound humility before the awesome power of nature.
examples.zh: 仰望著巍峨聳立的三千公尺崇山峻嶺，在浩瀚壯麗的大自然面前，每個登山者心中油然而生由衷的謙卑。

examples.en: Experienced mountain guides preach humility, reminding trekkers that the mountain always calls the shots.
examples.zh: 閱歷豐富的百岳老嚮導始終奉行謙卑心態，提醒隊員山林永遠是不可冒犯的最終主宰。

examples.en: Surrendering your ego and walking with quiet humility turns every alpine trek into a spiritual pilgrimage.
examples.zh: 放下傲慢執念、心懷謙卑踏出每一步，會讓每一次的高山遠征昇華為淨化心靈的朝聖之旅。

words.definition: 患難與共生死相依之登山隊友情誼

examples.en: Shared campfires and helping each other across difficult scree slopes forge lifelong mountain camaraderie.
examples.zh: 一起圍坐在寒夜營火旁喝熱茶、在險峻斷崖相互拉一把，淬鍊出患難與共、一生難忘的真摯隊友情誼。

examples.en: The grueling five-day expedition strengthened camaraderie among teammates who started as total strangers.
examples.zh: 艱苦卓絕的五天四夜重裝縱走，讓原本互不相識的萍水山友結下了生死與共的深厚情誼。

examples.en: Genuine camaraderie shines when someone voluntarily shoulders extra group gear for an exhausted partner.
examples.zh: 當看見隊友體力透支時有人主動分擔公裝與帳篷，這份情義正是山野間最純粹動人的隊友愛。

words.definition: 台灣高山山脈雄偉壯麗無比氣魄

examples.en: The breathtaking geographic majesty of Taiwan's rugged mountains leaves international travelers speechless.
examples.zh: 台灣高山島嶼那千峰競秀、氣勢磅礡的巍峨雄偉氣魄，令所有造訪的國際登山探險家驚嘆屏息。

examples.en: Standing on the summit of Dabajian, you are surrounded by the sheer geological majesty of jagged peaks.
examples.zh: 佇立在大霸尖山峰頂，周遭被千刀萬剮般的嶙峋群峰圍繞，盡顯鬼斧神工的磅礡氣魄。

examples.en: Writers and poets have long struggled to capture the boundless majesty of the snowy high mountains.
examples.zh: 歷代文人墨客無不竭盡筆墨，試圖描繪白雪皚皚之際崇山峻嶺那無可名狀的浩瀚雄偉之姿。

words.definition: 對守護這座島嶼高山聖靈的永恆敬仰

examples.en: Indigenous elders enter sacred alpine forests with prayers, demonstrating eternal reverence for the mountain spirits.
examples.zh: 原住民耆老在踏入高山神聖祖靈地前虔誠祈福，對守護這座島嶼千萬年的山靈展現永恆的虔誠敬畏。

examples.en: We should approach wild places with quiet reverence, recognizing that we are merely respectful guests.
examples.zh: 我們應當心懷由衷的崇敬踏入山林聖境，時刻自覺我們不過是這片神聖土地上短暫駐足的謙卑過客。

examples.en: His mountain photography reflects deep reverence for fragile alpine flora and untamed natural ecosystems.
examples.zh: 他的高山攝影作品洋溢著對脆弱高山植被與原始生態系統的深厚敬仰與無限溫柔。
